name: gaik-toolkit
description: GAIK agent skills. For developers building document pipelines with the gaik Python toolkit: choosing a document parser that preserves table structure, designing extraction schemas that stay inside provider limits, and building hybrid pgvector search whose failures are visible instead of silent. Ready-to-run use cases: turning a short brief into an editable slide deck with speaker notes, timing and citations, and Claude Desktop skills that write incident reports, construction site diaries, priced sales orders and structured reports.
